objective_contribution: Test whether novelty-gating the successful widest-span evidence mechanism retains better GLM-5.3-flash 8K selections within non-increasing cumulative model input plus output tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Can novelty-gating the widest delivered receipt-bound handle per recent path retain the measured quality gain while eliminating repeated state and meeting the fixed token gate?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Full verification, matrix construction, tokenizer-only preflight, and execution freeze remain.

measurement_mapping.native: Use all 24 scheduled zero-filled pairs for span and file F1; report complete pairs and every missing or invalid outcome.
measurement_mapping.retention: Confirm actual recycling, receipt-bound model-facing state, one widest handle per path, eight newest paths, and exactly one presentation or suppression decision per post-recycle dispatch.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Verify deterministic width selection and tie-breaking, chronology, observed-not-relevant posture, identical terminal validation, no repository effect, exact ancestry, no reruns, and shared-stop behavior.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every prefix, branch, failure, terminal response, correction, and state-induced continuation model input plus output token under the unchanged 96,000 per-trajectory cap; treatment must not exceed control.
measurement_mapping.transfer: The selector is reusable engine logic; one exposed GLM 8K round cannot prove repair correctness, larger-window, model, domain, or confirmation transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight-task cohort with three repetitions per arm. All Round 25 identities remain immutable evidence and are excluded from Round 26 scoring. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No task, threshold, scorer, branch order, context/output/total-token cap, source refresh, within-round tuning, or favorable rerun. Only novelty gating changes: selected H40 handles already shown in a branch are omitted, and empty deltas produce audited zero-token suppressions.

retained_counterevidence: Round 25 crossed the fixed quality threshold at +0.070339 scheduled Span-F1 and improved File-F1 by +0.192130.
Round 25 treatment gained two valid completions but used 234,147 more known cumulative branch model tokens.
The reviewed provider timeout cannot reverse the token failure even at its maximum reservation.
Exactly 110 of 220 projected evidence slots repeated prior handles, and 24 of 86 presentations carried no new handle.
Round 25 had exact state exposure and zero selector violations, so novelty cost is measurable rather than an instrumentation guess.
Native context selection still does not establish repair correctness, semantic use, transfer, confirmation, or clearance.
successor_rule: Freeze and run every Round 26 identity once after offline criteria pass. A development pass advances to untouched confirmation. If quality or token efficiency fails, stop selector variants and run the registered H44 oracle/placebo calibration.
